title: Geometric transit-depth scaling audit
question: How much of the expected transit-depth variation is explained by planet radius after accounting for host-star radius?
results: 4,711 unique planets with planet and host radii
slope approaches the area-law value 2 when host radius is restricted
validation: The relation is recomputed in four host-radius intervals and bootstrapped.
provenance: NASA Exoplanet Archive pscomppars preserved query
planet radius and stellar radius used to calculate geometric depth
limitations: calculated geometric depths are not fitted observed depths
limb darkening and impact parameter are omitted
